description: This file provides utility methods to build PayPal API request payloads, specifically for creating order payloads and converting minor currency units to major units as strings.

classes.name: PayPalPayloads
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for constructing PayPal API payloads related to payment orders.

methods.name: buildCreateOrderPayload
methods.description: Constructs a PayPal order creation payload as a Map, given currency and amount in minor units.

methods.name: minorToMajorString
methods.description: Converts an amount in minor units (like cents) to a string representing major units (like dollars), formatted with two decimal places.
